sources.title: Severe acute kidney injury predicting model based on transcontinental databases: a single-centre prospective study

evidence.text: A total of 2532 patients were admitted to our centre for prospective validation, and the prediction model made 16 858 times predictions.
The differences between the three databases partly reflect some demographic differences between Europe, the USA and China, resulting in a decline in the accuracy of the prediction model.
This retrospective multicentre study was unable to carry out more clinical feature mining and comparison because of different data structures.
There are 344 patients with severe AKI were diagnosed and the prediction accuracy was 83.5%.
Finally, given the low incidence of severe AKI and the great difference in the proportion of positive and negative samples, the data may be accidental.
The proportion of mechanical ventilation and the ICU stay time in AKI patients were longer with higher mortality.
The model with the highest area under the curve was XGBoost, 0.
The prospective research period was 1 January 2020-31 December 2020.
Above all, there was no significant difference between the prospective and the retrospective cohort.
In the retrospective study, we reduced the proportion of negative data by randomisation but retain all date in prospective phase with the sensitivity decreases.
There are some differences in the number of patients included in the three databases, which may affect the choice of variables.
All diagnosis of severe AKI needs to be reviewed by two ICU attending physicians independently, and if the they have different opinion, the third one will be appealed.

":"作为待验证假设，其依据引文支持跨库差异与前瞻-回顾无显著差异；但'公开ICU数据'前提未由原文证实，假设方向合理但范围需修正。"},{"claim_id":"c18","support_status":"supported","basis":"引文明确低发生率与正负样本比例差异可能使数据偶然，并报告通过随机化减少负样本比例，支持类别不平衡需处理的推理。"},{"claim_id":"c19","support_status":"supported","basis":"引文支持低发生率与样本不平衡问题及随机化处理策略，作为进一步调查方向有据；但针对'公开数据'的具体阳性比例仍需核查。"},{"claim_id":"c20","support_status":"supported","basis":"引文明确三个数据库纳入患者数量差异可能影响变量选择，支持公开ICU数据用于AKI预测需先确认变量可得性与样本量的条件性可行性判断。"},{"claim_id":"c21","support_status":"partially_supported","basis":"引文确认XGBoost为AUC最高模型，支持存在机器学习基线建模路径；但引文截断于'0.'，未给出完整配置，且未证明可复现性，需适配公开数据。"},{"claim_id":"c22","support_status":"uncertain","basis":"无证据支持，信息缺失；算力可行性未由原文报告，无法判断。"},{"claim_id":"c23","support_status":"supported","basis":"引文明确严重AKI诊断需两名ICU主治医师独立复核，分歧时由第三位裁定，支持验证阶段需明确标签判定与留出评估方案的推理。"}]}
